titre: Applying for a middle school or high school grant
resume: Automatic assessment at enrollment or an application before October 15: income limits, amounts, the tax notice to provide and the rules when parents are separated or have shared residence.
aQuoiCaSert: The middle school grant (bourse de collège) and the high school grant (bourse de lycée) help low-income families pay school costs. They are paid every term. For the 2026-2027 school year, what counts is the reference tax income (revenu fiscal de référence) on the 2026 tax notice for 2025 income. Most often, you apply by agreeing to automatic assessment at enrollment. This guide entry also covers the steps to enroll in middle school and high school.
quiEstConcerne: Families of a middle or high school student attending a public school, a state-contracted private school (privé sous contrat) or the Cned (national distance-learning center) in a full class.
Parents of a child in CM2 (last year of primary school) moving up to 6e (first year of collège), or in 3e moving up to high school.
Separated parents: only one parent can apply.
aSavoir: Middle school grant 2026-2027: €40, €112 or €175 per term depending on income. 2025 income limits: €18,488 for 1 dependent child, €22,754 for 2, €27,020 for 3, €31,286 for 4, €35,553 for 5, €39,819 for 6, €44,085 for 7, €48,352 for 8 or more.
High school grant 2026-2027: 6 levels (échelons), from €168 to €357 per term. Example for 1 dependent child: limit of €22,037 for level 1. The official simulator tells you your level.

Married couple or couple in a PACS (civil partnership): one joint tax notice. Unmarried couple living together: the couple's income counts, even if one partner is not the child's parent, with each partner's tax notice. Single parent living alone: only your tax notice.

Shared residence (middle school grant): the parents choose which of them applies. If both submit an application, both applications are inadmissible. A waiver signed by the other parent is not accepted.

Agreeing to automatic assessment, at enrollment or re-enrollment in a public school (and in some state-contracted private schools), counts as an application for the child's entire time in middle and high school. Without this agreement, you must apply again every year, even if the child had a grant the previous year.

Paid in 3 installments, usually at the end of December, the end of March and the end of June. In public schools, for a student who eats at the canteen (demi-pensionnaire) or boards (interne), canteen or boarding fees are deducted first.

In high school, a merit grant (bourse au mérite) can be added if the student passed the brevet with honors (mention). Without a tax notice on 2025 income, contact the school's social fund (fonds social).

Given out in CM2 for 6e, or with the high school placement decision.

Notice granting or refusing the grant

etapes.titre: Estimate your entitlement with the simulator
etapes.detail: Have your 2026 tax notice and the number of dependent children at hand. The simulator can be reached from the service-public.gouv.fr pages.

etapes.titre: At enrollment, agree to automatic assessment
etapes.detail: Online with EduConnect or on the paper file, in public schools. It's the simplest way: there is nothing else to do.

etapes.titre: Otherwise, apply between September 1 and October 15
etapes.detail: Online on Scolarité services with EduConnect, or on a paper form at the school office. For the Cned, paper form until October 31.

Full 2026 tax notice (both for unmarried couples), RIB, completed and signed form, proxy in private schools, residence judgment if you are separated. With shared residence, agree with the other parent on who applies.

etapes.titre: Submit the file to the school office before the deadline
etapes.detail: Ask for a receipt or note the date you submitted it.

If refused in middle school, you can appeal within 2 months to the head of the school or the rector (recteur). In high school, you have 15 clear days after notification to refer the matter to the rectorat (regional education authority) or the DSDEN (local education authority).

ou.detail: Enrollment, paper grant file and social fund.

ou.nom: Rectorat or DSDEN of your département
